svg.title: Quotient torus and embedded reference
svg.desc: A square with opposite edges identified beside a wireframe ring torus. Blue and yellow curves mark the two independent periodic directions.
svg.text: θ direction: left edge ≡ right edge
φ direction: lower edge ≡ upper edge
Embedded reference X(θ, φ), with Rmaj > rmin > 0
The quotient square defines the state topology; the embedding supplies an optional induced metric.
PROPOSED MATHEMATICAL MODEL · REPRODUCIBLE FIGURE · NOT EMPIRICAL TELEMETRY
